Hi Elena 

Thanks again for the call earlier — quick recap and next steps so we stay aligned on the MAP timeline: 

Summary (from today's discovery call)
- Primary use case: customer support triage + knowledge base augmentation (multi-language).
- Success criteria: >20% deflection and <200ms p50 latency for common queries.
- Integration: backend service + Redis cache; expected traffic ~10 qps initially.

Proposed MAP milestones (attached draft):
1) Agreement on SOW and target close date (target: 2028-04-20) — owner: Vertex procurement + Redwood AE
2) Security & network review complete — owner: Vertex security (2 weeks)
3) Pilot deployment + eval — owner: Vertex eng / Redwood Solutions (4 weeks)
4) Production cutover & monitoring runbook handoff — owner: Vertex platform team

Open asks for your procurement team: 
- Can you confirm whether 2028-04-20 is realistic for signature, or do you need an earlier runway for internal approvals?
- Who are the procurement approvers (name + role + email) so we can add them to the MAP as gatekeepers?
- Any additional legal or vendor-security artifacts you need besides the MAP and MSA?

Attached: Draft_MAP_Redwood_Vertex_20280315.xlsx (proposed milestones + owners).

If that target looks off, we can propose a staggered close (contract signature + PO by one date; pilot start on a later date). Would love to lock the procurement deadline this week and route a cleaned MAP to your approvers.

Best,
Jordan Blake

2) Approvers: attaching a short PDF with approver names (procurement, legal, and budget owner). The practical gatekeeper is Maria Gomez (Procurement Director) — maria.gomez@vertexai.com.
3) Legal: we'll need an MSA redline from your legal team — we typically do a single round of redlines.

Two clarifying questions: 
- Can the pilot be scoped to limit initial tokens and run on a dedicated test pool? That helps with cost approvals.
- Who from Redwood will be listed as the technical owner for the pilot integration (we need a single contact for our platform team)?

I'll loop in Maria if we proceed, but wanted to give you a firm signature deadline so you can align the MAP.

Thanks,
